title: Ramón is an awesome tour guide!
text: Ramón was our tour guide to the Gothic Quarter today. His English is very easy to understand. He was able to customize our trip to focus on the history of the area as well as the various architecture. We also got to sample some chocolate from one of the oldest chocolate stores (Fargas). He gave us a good background about Flamenco before going into the Tarantos show which was an awesome show - around 40 minutes long. After the tour, he recommended Elche restaurant for their Paella and it did not disappoint at all. One of the best meals we've had in Barcelona. He also volunteered to take photos
author: Michael_H

title: Amazing experience
text:
We had an amazing time on this tour. Touring Pandas was easy to work with. They were friendly and efficient. Our tour guide was Olga, who was very informative and friendly. She provided a very good tour through the Gothic Quarter.

The Flamenco show was fantastic. They definitely showed passion, panache, and flair during the show. The tapas after the show were phenomenal. There were 12 in our group, and we all walked wrapped up the evening with full stomachs. The food was delicious.

I would highly recommend Touring Pandas, and I would not miss this tour.
